text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: p99 latency spike observed for streaming endpoints. p99 increased ~5x, p95 ~2x. Auto-alert triggered by SLO monitor. Investigating.

lina (oncall): seeing the alert. checking dashboards now. any deploys in last hour? @kevin @ranjit

kevin: I rolled a config change to prefix-hash-v3 at ~15:40 UTC. It's a low-risk prefix mapping change, but traffic did ramp after that.

ranjit: on it. grabbing cache stats. initial glance: prefix_cache.hit_rate dropped from ~92% to 27% across wavefront-prefetch-shards.

infra-bot: metric snapshot: prefix_cache.hit_rate=0.271, p99=1.2s, stream_stalls=423, evictions=1.3k/min

lina (oncall): OK that's suspiciously correlated. attempt quick mitigation: can we route traffic to v2 prefix hashing or disable the v3 flag? @maria

maria (eng-runtime): we have a rollout toggle. I can flip routing to prefer v2 variants, but it will cause transient cache coldness. Still better than sustained misses. Preparing command.

kevin: v3 changed salt order for some hashed prefixes. Might have changed bucketing which invalidated a lot of warm keys. We didn't anticipate this distribution skew. Sorry, my bad.

sam (sre): Customer impact check: CS reports streaming timeouts from a subset of users on eu-west. p50 still fine but p99 and streaming stalls cause replay errors. @amy-cs can you gather which customers are affected?

amy-cs: Confirmed: 3 enterprise tenants reporting severe degradation (streaming dropping tokens / slow responses). Raising customer escalation. CS wants ETA and mitigation.

lina (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) roll routing back to v2 immediately (maria) 2) ramp dedicated prefetch warmers to refill popular prefixes (ranjit) 3) enable graceful fallback for streaming: route to fallback model for 1s then resume (maria) 4) notify CS and customers (amy)

maria (eng-runtime): running rollback flip now:
```
# toggle to prefer prefix-hash-v2
curl -X POST 'https://control-plane.internal/feature-flags/prefix-hash-toggle' \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \n  -d '{preferred: v2, reason: live-mitigation:cache-miss}'
```

infra-bot: rollout toggle accepted. traffic shift starting. expected convergence ~3m. :white_check_mark:

ranjit: warming top prefixes (list from telemetry top-1k): launching prefix-warmers on 12 nodes. command:
```
./prefix-warmer --shard=12 --from=telemetry/top1k.json --concurrency=8
```

lina (oncall): good. monitoring p99 and hit_rate. Sam, can you watch eu-west customer logs and ping if errors persist?

sam (sre): watching. initial numbers: hit_rate climbing to 61% after flip, p99 down to ~450ms, stream_stalls dropping. Sending alert to #customer-impact with summary.

amy-cs: Notified the three tenants: we said we saw a prefix hash rollout correlated and that we're rolling back and warming caches. They asked for postmortem and SLA exposure. A CSM is on each call.

kevin: notes for postmortem: prefix-hash-v3 changed salt concatenation order (prefix+namespace vs namespace+prefix) which changed distribution for short prefixes. missed running canary with production-like key distribution.

lina (oncall): action items (assignments):
- kevin: prepare rollback RCA doc + sims for distribution. (due EOD)
- ranjit: run a tracing job to confirm no other shards affected and produce warmup metrics. (ASAP)
- maria: add a safety flag that prevents full rollouts if global hit-rate drops >10% in <15m. (PR and tests)
- sam: follow-up with CS on remaining errors and collect logs for p99 sessions.

ops-bridge-bot: @here live mitigation in progress. route rolled back to v2. warming. Please confirm if you cannot access runbooks.

lina (oncall): handing off to morning oncall: @kevin you'll be oncall for 8am-4pm UTC. Keep incident priority until p99 stable <300ms and hit_rate >85% for 30m.

kevin: acknowledged. will take point. will post updates every 30m or on significant changes. :thumbsup:

maria (eng-runtime): will follow up with a small guardrail PR. link: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pulls/4132

ranjit: warming finished. top1k warmed. hit_rate 88% now. p99 210ms. closing mitigation actions but keeping incident open for RCA.

amy-cs: customers confirm restored performance. marking customer impact as resolved. They requested a follow-up RCA and compensation details — CS to coordinate.

lina (oncall): closing notes: immediate mitigation successful. we will run full postmortem and link to this thread. thanks all for quick response. :party_parrot: 

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated — rollback + warmers. Severity: Sev2 -> monitoring. Next: RCA doc and production canary policy.
